# User interface layout The Solidatus user-interface is divided into four main functional areas in which the core capabilities of the platform can be found and used.
Areas of the User InterfaceCore capabilities and functions
Models interfaceViewing, building, editing, analysing, and sharing models that represent your data and reference landscapes.
Data Domains interfaceBuilding, searching, and browsing Data Domains, viewing Data Maps, and using Analytics Reports.
Connectors interfaceConfiguring, managing, and executing Connector Agents and Jobs to ingest metadata into Solidatus models.
Activities interfaceViewing, managing, and configuring model activities and the approvals workflow to collaborate on model building.
All four functional areas can be accessed in one click through the [top navigation bar](/the-user-interface/the-navigation-bar), which sits at the top of the Solidatus interface throughout all areas of the platform. The top navigation bar gets you from one functional area to another, and the right-hand side provides access to notifications, account settings, this help documentation, and other policy and legal documents. See [top navigation bar](/the-user-interface/the-navigation-bar) page for more detailed information on functions accessible through the bar. *** Visit all pages in this section to learn more about the functionality and features availabe across the Solidatus user interface.
